PreceptDef.label: sacred
PreceptDef.description: Rest and care after birth are sacred. Support is easier to recognize and gives +3 mood for five days. Neglect can be recognized after half a day and gives -6 mood for eight days.

PreceptDef.label: expected
PreceptDef.description: Postpartum care is expected, but it must fit the colony's circumstances. Active support gives +3 mood for five days. Neglect can be recognized after one day and gives -4 mood for five days.

PreceptDef.label: practical
PreceptDef.description: Basic care after birth is expected, but colony duties take priority. Active support gives +3 mood for five days. Only severe neglect causes a penalty: -4 mood for five days, beginning no sooner than one day after birth.
